selection_rule: User intent selects a lane; lane state never changes the global operating contract.

lanes.purpose: Software implementation roadmap, product code, schemas, UI, rules-engine and application features.
source_bundle: only source/program paths named by the selected work item
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Only for an explicit dependency or failure signature.

lanes.purpose: Implementation of the Multiversal UI Skin Runtime (UISR): Skin Pack runtime, presentation engines, reading/accessibility runtime, Skin Laboratory, skin materialization, gallery/assignment/persistence, packaging and Tier-C UI evidence.
source_bundle: Multiversal-app UISK design contracts named by the selected UISR work item
live application repository evidence limited to the UISR scope
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Do not read or mutate product-development/MCS state except for an explicit shared dependency or same-repository publication conflict. UI implementation does not pause the main product-development lane.

lanes.purpose: Governance architecture, repositories, CI, agent behavior, execution infrastructure, validation infrastructure and operational tooling.
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Product state may be read only to preserve or reconcile it; operations work may not silently start product implementation.

lanes.purpose: Game-system evaluation, world/game content design, mechanics design and content creation that does not itself authorize software implementation.
source_bundle: canonical source material needed for the requested domain
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Do not load software-roadmap control state unless the user asks to integrate the result into implementation.

lanes.purpose: The DWC speech-synthesis project and its corpus/training/inference workflow.
source_bundle: the current DWC checkpoint/evidence named there
live DWC artifacts supplied by the user
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Keep DWC isolated from the application product lane unless an explicit integration task requires both.

lanes.purpose: External research, tools/resources evaluation, vendor/open-source comparisons and technical investigation that does not itself mutate product state.
source_bundle: project constraints only when they affect the evaluation
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Research findings become product or operations work only through an explicit follow-on task.

lanes.purpose: Source ingestion, provenance, corpus coverage, licensing traceability and recovery of project source material.
lanes.cross_lane_reads: Source evidence may inform other lanes but does not select their work.
